source: MAFF/partner document, "ដំណំពោត" (Corn Crop), Section II.2: Corn as a raw material for industry
text:
Beyond direct food and feed use, the corn plant is also an important raw material for a range of small industries and household processing:

- The stalk and pith/core can be used to make paper, fiberboard, or as fuel for burning (charcoal/firewood substitute).
- Ground red corn cob is used as animal feed.
- Ground corn cob starch/meal is processed into glue and other adhesive products.
- Protein and starch extracted from corn are used in making medicines.
- Corn is also processed into bread, cooking oil, and soy sauce/other seasonings, among other products.
